milestones.title: Milestone 1: Harden The MVP Core
milestones.description: Make the current Telchines scaffold reliable enough to install and run on small public repos.

issues.title: Improve project init and config validation
issues.body: Tighten project bootstrap, validate `.tel/config.json`, and fail early on invalid or missing configuration.

issues.title: Add better run metadata, errors, and logging
issues.body: Improve structured run output, CLI error messages, and persisted metadata so failures are easier to diagnose and replay.

issues.title: Harden retrieval indexing across repo layouts
issues.body: Handle more repository shapes, excluded paths, and file-type edge cases in the local indexer.

issues.title: Tighten adapter execution and observation parsing
issues.body: Improve tool invocation behavior and normalize more failure patterns into stable observations.

issues.title: Expand fixture coverage for compile and sim failures
issues.body: Add more realistic benchmark and test fixtures covering distinct compile, lint, and simulation failure classes.

issues.title: Add install and CLI smoke tests for tel and telchines
issues.body: Verify both console entrypoints work in a clean install path and catch packaging regressions early.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Real Repair Workflow
milestones.description: Move from deterministic heuristics to a usable, model-backed repair loop with replay and validation.

issues.title: Define a provider interface for model-backed repair generation
issues.body: Refine the repair provider abstraction so heuristic and model-backed providers share the same workflow contract.

issues.title: Add a first pluggable local or remote model provider
issues.body: Implement one configurable provider backend that can generate patch proposals using a real model.

issues.title: Expand patch generation beyond missing semicolons
issues.body: Support several common compile and lint failure categories instead of a single heuristic fix.

issues.title: Add patch minimization and better validation summaries
issues.body: Reduce noisy diffs and explain validation outcomes more clearly in stored run artifacts and CLI output.

issues.title: Store prompt, context, and evidence for repair replay
issues.body: Persist the full context used for model-backed repair so runs remain replayable and auditable.

issues.title: Build repair benchmarks for multiple error classes
issues.body: Create benchmark cases that measure repair performance across several distinct compile and lint failure signatures.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Better Triage And Evidence Packs
milestones.description: Make regression triage useful on realistic failure sets with stronger clustering and grounded summaries.

issues.title: Improve triage clustering beyond exact signature grouping
issues.body: Cluster similar failures more robustly than simple signature equality.

issues.title: Add per-cluster summaries with likely root-cause hints
issues.body: Generate concise summaries and likely next actions for each failure cluster.

issues.title: Link triage clusters to code, spec, and log evidence
issues.body: Attach retrieved evidence packs directly to triage output so users can inspect why a cluster was formed.

issues.title: Add historical similarity search over stored runs
issues.body: Use the run store as a source of prior failures and similar cases for new triage requests.

issues.title: Support mixed log directories and larger regression sets
issues.body: Handle larger log sets, nested directories, and more varied log formats without fragile assumptions.

issues.title: Add triage output formats for humans and CI
issues.body: Support both readable summaries and machine-oriented structured output for CI integration.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Retrieval And Project Memory v1
milestones.description: Turn retrieval into a dependable grounding layer for repair, triage, and later generation workflows.

issues.title: Add file-type-aware chunking for RTL, docs, and logs
issues.body: Improve chunking strategy by content type so retrieval packs preserve more useful context boundaries.

issues.title: Improve task-aware ranking and evidence-pack assembly
issues.body: Tune retrieval and evidence packing separately for repair, triage, and future generation workflows.

issues.title: Support incremental project refresh and reindex
issues.body: Allow index refresh without full rebuilds where possible and keep project memory in sync with repo changes.

issues.title: Add retrieval tests against larger fixture corpora
issues.body: Expand retrieval evaluation using larger, more varied fixtures than the current minimal test corpus.

issues.title: Store citations in a cleaner user-facing format
issues.body: Normalize citations so evidence references are easier to display in CLI output and future UI surfaces.

issues.title: Define retrieval evaluation metrics and report output
issues.body: Add retrieval-specific metrics and reporting to the benchmark suite.

milestones.title: Milestone 5: First Model Integration
milestones.description: Connect Telchines to actual AI backends while preserving replayability and policy boundaries.

issues.title: Add model provider config to .tel/config.json
issues.body: Define configuration for provider selection, credentials, routing mode, and policy flags.

issues.title: Implement one local backend and one remote backend path
issues.body: Support at least one local model path and one remote model path behind the same provider abstraction.

issues.title: Record model call metadata for replay and audit
issues.body: Persist prompts, retrieved context, provider metadata, and responses so model-backed workflows stay traceable.

issues.title: Add no-egress and local-only enforcement
issues.body: Enforce policy flags that prevent remote calls when local-only or no-egress mode is enabled.

issues.title: Add provider-specific tests and fallback behavior
issues.body: Test model provider failure modes and ensure the CLI degrades cleanly when providers are unavailable.

issues.title: Document setup for supported model backends
issues.body: Add setup docs for local and remote provider configuration, auth, and expected environment variables.

milestones.title: Milestone 6: First Post-MVP Differentiator
milestones.description: Add the first workflow beyond repair and triage, with spec-to-SVA as the recommended initial differentiator.

issues.title: Define the spec-to-SVA input and output contract
issues.body: Specify CLI inputs, structured outputs, evidence requirements, and storage expectations for assertion generation.

issues.title: Build retrieval context packs for spec and RTL grounding
issues.body: Assemble task-specific context packs that combine spec text, RTL, and prior evidence for SVA generation.

issues.title: Generate candidate SVA artifacts with structured outputs
issues.body: Produce reviewable assertion drafts along with structured metadata and evidence references.

issues.title: Add a validation harness for generated assertions
issues.body: Validate generated assertions through parse, compile, or formal acceptance gates as available.

issues.title: Add SVA benchmark cases and scorecards
issues.body: Create benchmark fixtures and reporting so spec-to-SVA quality is measurable and replayable.

issues.title: Add the tel gen-sva CLI command
issues.body: Expose the first generation workflow through the Telchines CLI with clear output and artifact paths.
